page.layout: One column of running text, a dictionary of Aramaic and Syriac entries with Hebrew characters. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Catchword at bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: tes. Plural. הָדְמִין, & emphat. Syr. ܕܡܝܢ׃
הרם Ch. Myrtus. Plur. הַרְסִין. Hinc Regina Esther denominata fuit, Hadassa, Esth. 2. 7. Vide illic T. sec.
הרף Ch. Deturbavit, depulit, impulit, ut Hebraicè.

הדר Ch. Redire, reverti: Et sic idem est quod חזר, Ch. vel Syr. הדר. Item Honorare, honorem habere, vel exhibere, honore afficere: Pahel הַדֵּר Idè. Aphel אַהְדַּר Idem: Item Redire facere, reddere, restituere, convertere.
הדור Ch. Honoratus, honestus, Genes. 24. 65. in Jon. Item Tortuosum, inæquale, reflexum. Hinc בירת הדוחי Locus tortuosus, Levit. 16. 10. 21. 22. in Jon. Est qui explicat, מקום מדרון Locus declivis.
הדרא הדר Ch. Honor, gloria, decus, majestas.

הוא הו Chal. ܗܘ, ܗܘ Syr. Ille, ipse, illud, ipsum. Plur. Chald. אנון הינון Illi, ipsi. Syr. ܗܢܘ ܗܢܘ ܗܢܘ; Fœm. Ch. איהי היא Illa, ipsa, Syr. ܗܝ ܗܝ ܗܝ. Plural. הנין אינין Illæ, ipsæ, Syriac. ܗܢܝ ܗܢܝ ܗܢܝ. Diversam lectionem hujus Pronominis apud Syros, pro diversa puncti diacritici appositione, vel supra vel infra vocem, vide in Gram. Chaldaica & Syriaca Cap. 1.
ܗܘܢ Syr. Illeipse, Compositum ex הו הוא. Chaldaicè dicitur ההוא. ܗܘܢ ܗܘܢ Illeipse est.

page.notes: Mostly Hebrew, Aramaic and Syriac script, reproduced as best legible; the Syriac and vocalised Hebrew forms are uncertain in places and may contain errors. The small marks at the lower left corner are not transcribed.
